result:
Ran both gates on the unchanged tree, and probed the one step the checker doesn't self-control.

## Verdict: APPROVED. All three findings closed.

### Executed this run

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `node docs/crucible-20260907/phases/P00/check-lifecycle.mjs` | `LIFECYCLE_VERIFIED`, exit 0 |
| `npm run lint:ci` | "No ESLint warnings or errors", exit 0 |
| Source + test file hashes | identical to the versions I approved (`02e0eb0`, `26320a3`, `3ee3ac9`, `5ea4584`, test `eb27234`) |

### Oracle review

The checker's two controls are live on every invocation, not decorative. `verify(results.slice(1))` fails the sorted-name `deepEqual` at 3-vs-4; the forced `status:'failed'` on index 0 fails the `every(passed)` assertion. Both are wrapped in `assert.throws`, so if either stopped biting the script itself exits non-zero. Ordering is correct ? `verify(results)` on line 26 establishes exactly four elements before the mutants are constructed, so neither control can pass vacuously on an empty array. The report path is a fresh `mkdtemp` per run and `readFileSync` throws if vitest didn't write it, so a stale report can't satisfy the gate. Deleting the test file now fails loudly (vitest finds no files ? non-zero), and renaming a case fails the `deepEqual`. The name list is a strict pin in both directions ? a legitimate fifth lifecycle test will also fail until the list is updated ? which matches the `assert.equal(group.length, 9)` idiom already in `check.mjs`.

I probed the one step with no self-control, the `eslint tests/component-lifecycle.test.tsx --max-warnings 0` on line 29. There is no `.eslintignore` and no `ignorePatterns`, the JSON formatter confirms the file is genuinely linted rather than skipped, and a planted `useEffect(..., [])` with a missing dep on a `tests/*.tsx` path produces `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` and "ESLint found too many warnings (maximum: 0)". The step can fail. That closes the gap G1 opened when it narrowed to `dirs: ['src']`.

G1's wording now matches what the command measures. On the suppression claim it hands to me: two `eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` exist (`EventsPageClient.tsx:109`, `ProfilePageClient.tsx:34`), both present at HEAD, zero added by this change.

### One residual, correctly recorded

G2's EVIDENCE states the mutation control in prose rather than pasted failure output, and I still cannot re-execute it read-only. I can corroborate half of it directly: the "all files were restored" claim holds ? hashes match my approved versions, the four warnings reproduce on the HEAD sources, and the current tree lints clean. The mutation-failure half remains builder-attested. That is now visible in the ledger instead of absent, which is what the finding asked for.

Optional consistency nit, not a defect: `check.mjs` gives its eslint command a stdin canary; `check-lifecycle.mjs` gives its vitest step two controls but its eslint step none. Three lines would make it self-proving. I've executed that control externally this run, so the evidence exists either way.

G1 and G2 are green on the unchanged tree and their EVIDENCE lines can be finalized. G3 is this approval.
